studio_evolution.principle: Evolve the studio and local model together; existing tools are a starting point, not a permanent capability ceiling
studio_evolution.first_implementation: Extract shared testable action application and browser replay before introducing a tool registry
compatibility: Version design documents and tools separately
Record motor and tool versions in datasets
new_tool_gate: Base model evaluation before any new training
studio_evolution.retraining: Only if measured capability gap remains; short adaptation with old-skill regression checks

curriculum_priority.primary: existing AURA Forma design schema, vocabulary and actions; compiled studio edits and atelier overrides
curriculum_priority.before_gpu_pilot: Build and replay real Forma edit examples through runtime validation; geometry-v1 alone is not an AURA training readiness gate
curriculum_priority.units: Forma mm; legacy design-tools cm schema kept separate

benchmark.note: Full optimizer step includes all 8 micro batches; exclude kernel compilation and 10 warmup steps from steady-state timing.

planning_note: Hypothetical sensitivity inputs, NOT measured GPU benchmarks or performance guarantees.

stages.scope: unreviewed exercise DSL; not AURA/CAD integration or aesthetics

vision_stage: Separate benchmark required; image tokens/resolution change memory and speed. Not included in text-stage duration.

scale_up_only_if: No invalid geometry rate increase on dev
Exact edit and repair accuracy improves versus base on held-out groups
Existing command and vision evaluation shows no material regression
Kernel/memory benchmark and revised duration logged
progression.if_no_gain: Inspect labels/format and run at most one corrected pilot; do not launch the 6000-example run automatically.
progression.no_gain_warning: Thresholds and independent human-reviewed evaluation must be fixed before reading model results; current exercise labels remain provisional.

gates: Exact local tokenization: no silent truncation; split or reject sequences longer than context
Source/license checks; group-held-out split; no dev/test examples in training
Current engine labels stay unreviewed; no official-gold or aesthetic-quality claim
Record base dev result before adaptation and compare after adaptation
No unsafe-pass increase; command and vision regression evaluation before release
Copy adapter, base revision, processor/template and training logs locally before releasing GPU
Validate merged model and local quantized export independently
